scoreInterpretation: Comparative visual evidence against original, fixed target and round02, not a numeric pass threshold. Approval follows resolved visible blockers and passing actual constraints.

observations.evidence: Moss is visibly thicker and rounded, with connected lobes flowing down crown stones and over upper/rear/side contacts. The round02 isolated oval caps and North rear badge have been replaced by attached growth. Crown volume and contact remain readable in the phone repeated scene; the highest growth is no longer a flattened disk.

The crown/forehead and head now have softer irregular perimeter changes and broad worn planes, while the face remains coherent and recognizable. The cobalt foot has uneven tapered shoulders, angled side planes and a less regular lower silhouette, replacing the straight octagonal slab appearance. These changes read at logical/phone size rather than relying on the former thin crack lines.

Heavy brow, inset eyes, long nose, lower lip and ears form one substantial pale carved face on a full-cell blue rock foot. Native silhouettes and thickness agree across all four facings. The quiet rear is a continuous stone mass with purposeful growth and grounded vegetation, without an invented second face.

Ivory highlights and pale cool midtones separate stone from rounded green moss, darker green thick sprouts and cobalt facets. The finish stays warm, matte and readable without clipped white crown planes, fluorescent moss or an all-over yellow wash.

Broad soft upper light reveals the changed stone and growth volumes while retaining horizontal balance. Eye recesses and lower stone/reef planes stay readable; no preferred left/right world light or directional ground cast shadow is visible.

The four-view phone row and72x96 W12 thumbnail retain the face and three material masses. The repeated3x3 scene shows the improved moss/stone silhouette clearly, and the recorded6x4 scene keeps the submarine/eel actor hierarchy. Landscape/desktop contexts remain coherent.

No blocking alpha halo, speckles, clipping, black dead spots, broken normals, exposed mesh ends, disconnected debris or incorrect facing labels were found. Large calm stone planes are deliberate and retain tone/volume; they are not rendered dead spots.

criteriaAssessment.reason: Substantial coherent stone face and grounded reef mass, with softened irregular forms rather than untouched clean bar boundaries.
Rounded integrated growth, broad worn stone/reef plane changes, sparse fracture detail and grounded foliage/rubble communicate material and age at use size.
Warm ivory/cool pale shading, controlled green and readable cobalt preserve palette identity without glare.
Soft controlled form separation, symmetric horizontal light and readable lower planes; no directional ground shadow.
Identity and material hierarchy survive actual phone Fit scenes and library thumbnail; actors remain distinct.
Consistent native volume/finish and purposeful growth across all facings; calm rear planes are allowed by frozen criteria.
No material defects in inspected native exports, alpha contexts or actual consumer previews.

remainingDifferences: Native stone has fewer small chips and fractures and lacks the target's painterly fine grain. Its broad worn forms, moss contacts and reef planes carry material and age at game size, so target microdetail is not required.

The native finish is quieter and less glossy than the target's golden edge sheen. This rough matte treatment remains soft and warm with symmetric light; reproducing the target's directional sheen is unnecessary.
The fixed target fills more of its normalized canvas and includes an exterior yellow/green fringe. The approved native output retains registered framing/scale and omits that drift.
Exact crown count, individual crack/plant/pebble placement and unseen target views are not requirements. Broad calm rear/side planes and a single frontal face are accepted.
